## Accuracy Audit Checklist
- [ ] All resource URLs verified (live + content accurate)
- [ ] Statute citations verified against source
- [ ] Contact info current (addresses, hours, eligibility)
- [ ] Resource descriptions match live websites
- [ ] No broken links or 404s
- [ ] Phone numbers and service areas current
